eve.text: Isilu is at the center of a plot as Maralen seeks Ashling's help while Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot. In the fight with the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves, Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove, and Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her.

Oko reveals that he orchestrated the whole ordeal and cures his sister, and Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle. The two reemerge after the final Great Aurora to control the plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor, as Oona's death had collapsed the artificial cycles and brought the Pendulum Year.

ecl.text: Isilu, the moon-headed elemental, is accidentally woken in a cave when students find it sleeping at the center of a silver-lit chamber and Sanar touches its neck. It wakes and roars, and a wave of darkness floods the meadow, turning day to night and transforming the landscape.

Brigid explains that Isilu should be sleeping rather than stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in their territories, and when Isilu walks past Goldmeadow the village is transformed into its Shadowmoor aspect. Morcant sees Isilu's vulnerability as a chance to end the night forever and plans to poison it with dawnglove.

As the elves advance, Isilu lowers its head to Ashling and begins circling the party protectively. In the end Isilu and Eirdu answer each other's calls and, instead of fighting, wrestle in play, after which Isilu heads back toward its cavern as the night recedes and the transformed kithkin and elves return to their Lorwyn selves.
